'''OC-JK14''', also known as '''Seejay''', was an [[astromech droid]] who served the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. It served at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]], where it could often be found underfoot while roaming the undergrowth looking to be productive. The [[droid]] quietly tended to low-priority maintenance jobs and crossed them off to-do lists that few ever looked at.<ref name="TROS VD" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> OC-JK14 was among those in the base who gathered around the body of [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to mourn her [[death]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

An older model of treadwell style astromech droid that was once popular in the [[Outer Rim Territories]], OC-JK14 was often overlooked by Resistance members, who were drawn to more traditional astromechs. The astromech had a [[Color|yellow]] and blue [[plasteel]] drum body with a gray multi-spectrum [[photoreceptor]]. Its treadwell base had a recessed door to a compartment that contained a variety of tool-tipped manipulators.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
OC-JK14 appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Concept art of the droid titled "Droid 02" was produced for the film by creature concept designer [[Luke Fisher]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref>
